svg.title: Capturing current and markers with a PPK2 from Python, run by a developer, a CI job or an AI coding assistant
svg.desc: From top to bottom: a developer, a CI job and an AI coding assistant; a host with the three layers of ppk2-lib, the ppk2 command on ppk2.client on ppk2.protocol; a PPK2 on USB; a DUT whose firmware raises GPIO markers on the digital inputs of the PPK2, which supplies it and measures its current. Beside the stack, the host writes capture.csv and capture.ppk2, the formats of the Power Profiler app. At the right, the current of the capture with its two marked regions, and the width, mean current and charge of each.
svg.text: Checked against the Power Profiler app:
